title: How much does 23 × 27 grow when one number grows by 1?
description: The dot diagram of twenty three rows and twenty seven columns gets one new column, then one new row. The distributive property shows what each one adds. Keeko doubts that the total grows only by one.
teaching_notes: One idea: when one number of a multiplication grows by one, the total grows by the other number. Watch for students who think the total grows by one because one number grew by one.

source: 23 × 27 = 621. By how much does the product increase if 27 i
video_script.why: The child can multiply, but does not yet see how a total changes when one of its two numbers grows by one.
video_script.substitution: Split twenty seven plus one into its two parts, multiply each part by twenty three, and add.
video_script.anchor: the book's dot diagram of twenty three rows and twenty seven columns
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko says the total grows by one, because only one number grew by one. The new column holds one dot in each of the twenty three rows, so the total grows by twenty three.
video_script.payoff_line: A number that grows by one adds the other number once

final_answer.value: Increasing 27 by 1 adds 23; increasing 23 by 1 adds 27
final_answer.spoken: twenty seven growing by one adds twenty three, and twenty three growing by one adds twenty seven

never_show: a total that grows by 1, marked as right
maths_rules: distributive property: a(b + c) = ab + ac; (a + b)c = ac + bc
the diagram has 23 rows and 27 columns; the new column has 23 dots; the new row has 27 dots
video_script.design: One idea: a number that grows by one adds the other number. Assumes multiplication as rows and columns. Wrong idea: the total grows by one. The dot diagram stays through the idea and the doubt.

narration: <bookmark mark='rows'/>Take eigh rows of dots, with b dots in each row.
<bookmark mark='more'/>Add c more columns, so each row has b plus c dots.
<bookmark mark='count'/>Count the two blocks separately and add them. That gives eigh b plus eigh c.
Splitting a multiplication over a sum like this is called the distributive property.
<bookmark mark='given'/>Given, twenty three times twenty seven is six hundred twenty one.

narration: <bookmark mark='split'/>Step one, grow twenty seven by one and write twenty seven plus one in brackets.
<bookmark mark='dist'/>The distributive property gives twenty three times twenty seven, plus twenty three times one.
<bookmark mark='col'/>The second part is the new column, one dot in each of the rows.
<bookmark mark='old'/>Step two, put in the values. Twenty three times twenty seven is six hundred twenty one.
<bookmark mark='sum'/>Adding the new column gives six hundred forty four, which is twenty three times twenty eight.

narration: <bookmark mark='split2'/>Step three, grow twenty three by one and write twenty three plus one in brackets.
<bookmark mark='dist2'/>Distributing from the other side gives twenty three times twenty seven, plus one times twenty seven.
<bookmark mark='row'/>The second part is the new row, with twenty seven dots.
<bookmark mark='sum2'/>Step four, add the new row to six hundred twenty one.
That gives six hundred forty eight, which is twenty four times twenty seven.
